# Release notes: Oracle plugin

## October 16, 2026

Edition    | Version  | Vault requirement
---------- | -------- | -----------------
Enterprise | `0.15.0` | 1.21.0+

### Features and bug fixes ((#0150-updates))

- Added support for rotating self-managed static role passwords without the
  `ALTER USER` privilege. Use the `REPLACE` clause with the new
  `{{current_password}}` template variable in `rotation_statements`.
- Redacted passwords from password rotation error messages.
- Updated `golang.org/x/crypto` and other modules to resolve reported CVEs.

### Technical updates ((#0150-tech))

- Bumped `go` version from 1.26.1 to 1.27.2.
- Bumped Oracle Instant Client from 19.26 to 19.31.
- Added a `linux/s390x` build.
- Included the EULA and Terms of Evaluation in the release archive.
